function.name: mallocspy_grow
function.description: This function allocates or reallocates memory for the 'blocks' member of the 'allocator' object. The size of the allocated memory is determined by the 'length' parameter. If the allocation is successful, the function updates the 'blocks' and 'blocks_length' members of the 'allocator' object.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: This parameter determines the size of the memory to be allocated or reallocated for the 'blocks' member of the 'allocator' object.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the memory allocation or reallocation is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: mallocspy_add_mem
function.description: This function adds a memory block to the allocator. It finds a free location in the allocator's blocks, grows the blocks if necessary, and increments the count of spied allocations.

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: This is the memory block to be added to the allocator.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: mallocspy_remove_spyed_memory
function.description: This function removes a memory block from the list of spyed allocations. It checks if the memory block is spyed and if so, it decrements the count of spyed allocations and sets the pointer to the memory block to NULL.

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the memory block that should be removed from the list of spyed allocations.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the memory block was successfully removed from the list of spyed allocations, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: allocator_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IMalloc. If it does, it assigns the address of allocator.IMalloc_iface to the provided object pointer and returns S_OK. If it doesn't, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMalloc interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the object where the interface pointer will be stored if the interface is supported

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: allocator_AddRef
function.description: This function returns a static value of 2

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMalloc interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a static value of 2

function.name: allocator_Release
function.description: This function releases an allocated memory block.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the operation, 1 indicates success

function.name: allocator_Alloc
function.description: This function allocates memory of size 'cb' and returns the address of the allocated memory. If the allocator spy is active, it also interacts with the IMallocSpy interface before and after the allocation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMalloc interface which is used for memory allocation

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The size of the memory to be allocated

function.return_type: void*: Represents the address of the allocated memory. Returns NULL if the allocation fails.

function.name: allocator_Realloc
function.description: This function reallocates a memory block according to the size specified, with additional functionality for memory spying. If the allocator.spy is active, it removes the spied memory, performs pre-reallocation operations, and checks if the spy can be released. If the size is zero, it frees the memory. It also handles post-reallocation operations if the spy is active.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMalloc interface

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block that needs to be reallocated

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The new size for the memory block

function.return_type: void*; Returns a pointer to the reallocated memory block, or NULL if the function fails to allocate the requested block of memory or if the size is zero

function.name: allocator_Free
function.description: This function frees a memory block in the heap. If the memory block is being spied on, it removes the spy before freeing the memory and performs necessary cleanup after freeing.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMalloc interface which provides methods for allocation and deallocation

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block that needs to be freed

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: allocator_GetSize
function.description: This function gets the size of a memory block allocated from a specific heap. It also handles the case when the memory block is being spied on.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMalloc interface which is used for memory allocation operations.

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block whose size is to be determined.

function.return_type: SIZE_T, represents the size of the memory block. Returns -1 if the memory block pointer is null.

function.name: allocator_DidAlloc
function.description: This function checks if a memory block was allocated by the allocator. It also handles the case when a spy is active, adjusting the allocation status accordingly.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for memory allocation

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block to be checked

function.return_type: INT, represents whether the memory block was allocated by the allocator (-1 if the memory block is NULL, otherwise the result of HeapValidate or IMallocSpy_PostDidAlloc)

function.name: allocator_HeapMinimize
function.description: This function minimizes the heap memory allocation. If the spy is active, it calls the pre-heap minimize and post-heap minimize functions of the IMallocSpy interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMalloc interface which is used for memory allocation operations.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: CoGetMalloc
function.description: This function checks if the context is equal to MEMCTX_TASK. If it is, it assigns the address of allocator.IMalloc_iface to the pointer to pointer imalloc and returns S_OK. If it is not, it assigns NULL to imalloc and returns E_INVALIDARG.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: This parameter represents the context which is checked against MEMCTX_TASK.

parameters.name: imalloc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to pointer to IMalloc. The function assigns the address of allocator.IMalloc_iface or NULL to this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the context is not equal to MEMCTX_TASK.

function.name: CoTaskMemAlloc
function.description: This function allocates a block of memory of a specified size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the size of the memory block to be allocated.

function.return_type: void pointer, represents the starting address of the allocated memory block.

function.name: CoTaskMemFree
function.description: This function is used to free a memory block that was allocated with CoTaskMemAlloc or CoTaskMemRealloc.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the memory block that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: CoTaskMemRealloc
function.description: This function reallocates a block of memory. The size can be either greater or less than the original size.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the memory block that was previously allocated with CoTaskMemAlloc or CoTaskMemRealloc.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: This is the new size for the memory block, in bytes.

function.return_type: void *: This is a pointer to the reallocated memory block. If the function fails to allocate the requested block of memory, a null pointer is returned.

function.name: CoRegisterMallocSpy
function.description: This function registers a MallocSpy object. It checks if the object is already registered or if the object is null. If not, it registers the object and returns a success HRESULT, otherwise it returns an error HRESULT.

parameters.name: spy
parameters.description: This is the MallocSpy object that is to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the object is successfully registered, CO_E_OBJISREG if the object is already registered, and E_INVALIDARG if the object is null.

function.name: CoRevokeMallocSpy
function.description: This function revokes a previously registered IMallocSpy object. It handles the process of deregistering the spy, releasing it, and handling any errors that may occur during this process.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and status codes. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the spy object is not registered, it returns CO_E_OBJNOTREG. If there are allocations being spied upon, it returns E_ACCESSDENIED.
